title: Comparison between different mesoporous carbons in the removal of doxycycline antibiotic: experimental assays and description of adsorbate features by density functional theory (DFT)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00336A, Paper
Tauany de Figueiredo Neves, Thayna Reis, Natália Gabriele Camparotto, Maria Vitória Rapôso Rodrigues, Valmor Roberto Mastelaro, Rafael L. Oliveira, Patrícia Prediger
